defect.title: one failing capture plan aborts the step, and the plans after it produce no evidence at all
defect.severity: the reason a records-only push loses the whole-task bundle, and the reason W-7 stays a guess
defect.status: FIXED in this branch, pending hosted confirmation
defect.mechanism: The capture step ran under `set -euo pipefail` and no step may be given continue-on-error (asserted by tests/contracts/UDG-001.test.ts), so the first plan whose bundle recorded a failure returned non-zero and the shell loop aborted. Plans later in CAPTURE_PLANS (UDG-003, UDG-003-TASK, UDG-004) never ran.
whyItMatters: W-7 fires inside the test command of the UDG-002 plan, so it aborts the loop before UDG-003-TASK exists: the whole-task bundle, the Phase 3 vectors and the task measurements are lost precisely on the runs that need them.
A red on a records-only push loses four bundles' evidence, so the run answers nothing.
It is a second amplification: a product defect inside a capture removes evidence from unrelated tasks.

runsAffected.note: This is the run the reviewer asked to have classified. It is the first hosted sighting whose bytes name which W-7 assertion moved, and the first whose shape shows the loop abort rather than a verification complaint.
Classified separately in UDG-003-phase-3-impairment-gate-red-run-44211208860.json; the retained evidence showed only three bundles because the loop aborted at UDG-003.
Classified separately; same abort, three bundles.

case.class: UDG-003 Phase 2 runtime — the P-batch: impairment (OD-2) and the stage sequence (OD-4)
case.name: W-7: the 4000 ms episode deadline expires with no fresh snapshot, and the three limits stay distinct

whatTheBytesSupport: Two hosted sightings of the same accepted case, on two different lines of it: 702 (deliveries reaching the seat) and 704 (state applications during the episode). Both counted something that should have been zero, in the same silent window.
The case reads workspace/UntitledDinosaurGame/artifacts/udg-003-phase-2/transport-impairment.json, so the assertion is identified by the junit failure's own line, not by the log's prose.
whatTheBytesDoNotSupport: They do not contain the artefact the case actually read, so the other 83 audited values around the moved counter are unknown, and the cause remains undemonstrated. That gap is what W-A-3 closes.
They do not attribute the movement to a timer, a socket event, a patch frame or a scheduler.

behaviour: attempts every plan in `evidence.js plans`, no `set -e` around the captures
names each bundle it retains in the step summary
prints the failing commands of each failed plan, so the producer's gate refusal is in the log rather than inferred from a step name
exits 1 if any plan failed, so the step still fails, and exits 1 if the plan list is empty
fix.ci: the step still names `pnpm evidence:capture -- --task TASK --out artifacts --keep-going`, passed as --capture-cmd, and still names `evidence.js plans`
fix.tests: tests/unit/udg-003/capture-loop.test.ts drives the loop with a stub and asserts the UDG-002-shaped abort: all five plans attempted, every bundle including UDG-003-TASK retained, exit 1

acceptedAssertionAmendment.now: the step must call the loop, and the loop file must contain the plan-list `for task in` iteration, the production capture invocation, --keep-going, no `set -euo` and an `exit 1`
acceptedAssertionAmendment.justification: The assertion pinned the iteration to the step text. The owner directed that every plan be attempted and all evidence retained, which an inline loop under the accepted `set -euo pipefail` cannot do. Same substance, read from the script CI executes.
